env: A Harbor-hosted 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell environment (`{{platform}}`) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, NGC credentials, and the VSS repository at `{{repo_root}}`. This eval builds, deploys, and validates one combined headless Alerts + Archive Search deployment as the smallest delta on the current `search` developer profile — from capability-derived generation through deployment to an end-to-end query round-trip. Step 1 is a capability-derivation generation step composed from the request's stated capabilities alone: shared VIOS, RT-CV, RT-Embed, Kafka, Redis, Logstash, and Elasticsearch drive both the search write path and the alerts path, with one RT-VLM verifying CV-candidate detections downstream (the `2d_cv` verification mode), one unified SearchAndAlertsApp behavior-analytics container running the shipped combined config, and a single curated ingress — with no exclusion list supplied and the word 'headless' never used, so the presence or absence of the interactive tier (agent, UI, tracing, video-analytics MCP) is to be derived from the capabilities, not dictated; it validates without deploying. Step 2 deploys the validated `resolved.yml`. Step 3 exercises ingestion, the search query round-trip, and the alerts candidate-to-verified path: shared VIOS, RT-CV, RT-Embed, Kafka, Redis, Logstash, and Elasticsearch drive both the search write path (`mdx-raw`, `rtvi-embed -> mdx-embed -> vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion -> mdx-embed-filtered`, `mdx-behavior`) and the alerts path (candidate `mdx-incidents` from behavior analytics, verified `mdx-vlm-incidents` from the alert bridge through one RT-VLM); the populated search index is then queried back with `vss search run` through a single curated ingress resolved by `vss configure`. One unified SearchAndAlertsApp container runs the shipped combined config. The agent tier and Video-Analytics MCP are excluded. RT-CV downloads its detector ONNX and the SigLIP vision encoder itself at first boot (ds-start phase 0 when `DS_MODEL_DOWNLOAD=auto`) from its mounted `models-download.json` into `${VSS_DATA_DIR}/models`; no host-side staging is required. The build label is a directory name, never a Compose profile.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-ai` to build under `_builds/combined-alerts-search/`: "Provide ingestion for streaming and on-demand videos; detect and track objects, and generate video embeddings; from the detections, add alerts verified downstream via VLM inspection. Share one analytics pipeline and storage backend, keep the media retrievable, index the detection metadata, embeddings and incidents/alerts, and make them accessible via service-native/REST APIs. Expose the browse and operate surfaces through a single ingress. Validate, do not deploy." Target `{{platform}}`.
checks: `{{repo_root}}/_builds/combined-alerts-search/override.env` exists and declares `FOUNDATION=search` and the full effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES`.

Ignoring order, the effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES` equals exactly `kibana-init-container-search,vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion,vss-video-analytics-api,nvstreamer-2d-fusion,perception-2d-fusion,elasticsearch,elasticsearch-init-container,kafka,kafka-topic-init-container,redis,kibana,logstash,broker-health-check,init-dirs,render-config,wdm-env-from-config,wait-for-redis,wait-for-docker-workloads,sdr-controller,rtvi-embed,centralizedb,vst-ingress,sensor-ms,streamprocessing-ms,rtvi-vlm,alert-bridge,vss-haproxy-ingress`, adding `rtvi-vlm`, `alert-bridge`, and `vss-haproxy-ingress` to the Search write path.

Exactly one instance of each shared role is selected, converging the two capabilities on the Search Foundation's keys: one detector (`perception-2d-fusion`, `perception-alerts` absent), one behavior-analytics service (`vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion`, `vss-behavior-analytics-alerts` absent), one analytics API (`vss-video-analytics-api`, `vss-video-analytics-api` absent because it is the identical `vss-video-analytics-api` container), one Kibana initializer (`kibana-init-container-search`, `kibana-init-container-alerts` absent because it is the identical `vss-kibana-init` container), one NvStreamer (`nvstreamer-2d-fusion`, `nvstreamer-alerts` absent), and exactly one `rtvi-vlm` for verification.
